d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Linda Miao is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Linda kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.

d41: 🌲 Something still paces the treeline beyond the walls — The Ugly Beast — waiting for a dead Linda. It doesn't come in. The walls end the argument. (Haven is sanctuary. It'll still be out there when the new bearer leaves.)
d41: "Linda's gone." Wei looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Linda." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Ashley blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Linda Miao, 41 days. The mantle passes to Ashley Foster.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Ashley Foster, 33 — a comic shop owner. Her hands know different work now: The Touch.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Linda — and Linda is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Angela, Johana, Wei and 4 more speak for Ashley — "Linda trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Ashley before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
